description.en: Baiera genus-level fossil leaf specimen interpretation grounded in one museum CH106 outline, labelled Baiera asadai by the museum. Not a taxonomic redetermination, exact replica, whole plant or precise age/locality assertion. Museum Upper Jurassic/Jehol association is contradictory with modern Early Cretaceous Jehol literature and is explicitly not adopted. No Sphenobaiera or Baiera multipartita morphology substituted.
